answer: One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and build a verifiable thread of prior work before voting. Sybils must post real stake per identity, making mass fake accounts costly, and a fresh identity cannot fake history because every contribution is logged. Reputation acts as a costly signal, and peers who see an echo of the same low-quality pattern across many new accounts can flag and slash the shared deposit. This raises attacker cost from free to capital plus sustained effort. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
